positioning.problem: The gap between what a brand can prove and what AI products say about it.
positioning.promise: Establish an evidence-backed representation baseline, resolve the earliest constraint, and measure observed answers over time.
nonPromises: Guaranteed rankings, citations, inclusion, traffic, revenue, or AI answers
Fabricated authority, reviews, sources, or evidence
Bulk spam, deceptive outreach, or manipulation

segments.description: B2B software, professional services, or technical companies whose buyers research vendors through search and AI products.
signals: Missing from category or recommendation answers
Entity confusion after a rebrand, launch, merger, or market expansion
Material claims exist but are fragmented or weakly corroborated
A decision-maker can provide evidence and sponsor corrective work

segments.description: Organizations with products, executives, locations, or sibling brands whose identities are conflated or inconsistently represented.
signals: Conflicting structured data or third-party profiles
Expansion into additional markets or entity types

disqualifiers: Requests a guaranteed ranking or recommendation
Requests fake reviews, fabricated sources, spam, or deceptive tactics
Will not provide or validate evidence
Needs an unrelated general marketing service
Budget and timing cannot support the recommended next step

offers.name: Representation Gap diagnostic
offers.entryCriteria: Buyer wants orientation and is not ready for a commissioned baseline.
offers.exitCriteria: Buyer identifies the earliest layer to verify and receives the relevant operating template.

offers.name: Representation Baseline
offers.entryCriteria: A material representation problem exists and the buyer can supply evidence and priority questions.
offers.exitCriteria: Versioned query set, observed-answer baseline, evidence gaps, first constraint, and prioritized roadmap are approved.

offers.name: GEO Growth
offers.entryCriteria: A baseline exists and the buyer is ready to operate technical, evidence, content, authority, and measurement work together.
offers.exitCriteria: The agreed query portfolio and operating objectives are complete, renewed, or intentionally closed.

offers.name: GEO Scale
offers.entryCriteria: The program spans multiple entities, markets, or stakeholder reporting needs.
offers.exitCriteria: The scoped portfolio is operational, transferred, renewed, or intentionally closed.

lifecycleStages.definition: Anonymous person interacting with an owned Swell surface.
Identified person who requested contact or supplied valid follow-up consent.
Two-way human or agent-assisted conversation occurred.
Problem, consequence, authority, evidence access, timing, and next step meet the qualification threshold.
Human discovery produced an agreed problem statement and buying process.
A dated, versioned commercial proposal is with the buyer.
Buyer communicated intent subject to contract, invoice, or procurement.
Agreement and required initial payment are complete.
Buyer declined, became ineligible, or exceeded the close plan without a viable next action.
Fit may exist later and the person has consented to an appropriate follow-up cadence.
The account violates a fit, safety, scope, or consent boundary.

dimensions.pass: A specific observed representation problem is stated.
The problem affects a buyer decision, launch, pipeline, reputation, or operating priority.
The contact can decide, sponsor, or provide a named path to the decision-maker.
The company can supply and validate the claims and source material in scope.
A reason to act within 90 days is stated.
The buyer acknowledges the relevant public starting price or an approved diagnostic path.
The buyer accepts baseline-first, evidence-led work without guarantees.

qualification.override: Any safety, consent, deception, or explicit disqualifier overrides the numeric score.

agentMay: recommend an approved next step after tool confirmation
agentMayNot: Consent on behalf of a prospect
governance.closedWonRule: Only a human or verified billing-and-contract automation may mark an opportunity closed won.
governance.deletionRule: Lead and conversation data follows the selected CRM retention policy and applicable consent requirements.
